title: 健康与生活方式
desc: 涵盖身体健康、作息睡眠、心理压力、劳逸平衡、不良习惯与健康倡导的考场表达

entries.example: Regular jogging and swimming are effective ways to build physical fitness and relieve daily tension.
entries.exampleZh: 经常慢跑和游泳是增强体能、缓解日常紧张的有效方式。
entries.note: 不可数；配build/maintain；与mental health对举。

entries.example: A balanced diet and enough sleep contribute greatly to our physical and mental well-being.
entries.exampleZh: 均衡饮食和充足睡眠对我们的身心健康大有裨益。
entries.note: 不可数；配promote/undermine well-being。

entries.example: Despite his age, my grandfather stays in good shape by walking five kilometres every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管年纪不小，我祖父每天早晨步行五公里，身体保持得很好。
entries.note: 配keep/stay in good shape；反义out of shape。

entries.example: A thirty-minute workout three times a week can work wonders for your energy level.
entries.exampleZh: 每周三次、每次三十分钟的锻炼就能显著改善你的精力状况。
entries.note: 可数，复数workouts；动词分开写work out。

entries.example: Those who exercise regularly are far less likely to be troubled by chronic diseases.
entries.exampleZh: 经常锻炼的人患慢性病的可能性要小得多。
entries.note: 副词regularly后置；可用take regular exercise。

entries.example: Office workers tend to be sedentary, sitting in front of screens for over eight hours daily.
entries.exampleZh: 上班族往往久坐不动，每天在屏幕前坐上八个多小时。
entries.note: 作表语或定语；与physically active对照。

entries.example: A sedentary lifestyle, combined with junk food, has fuelled the rise of obesity among teenagers.
entries.exampleZh: 久坐不动的生活方式加上垃圾食品，助推了青少年肥胖率的上升。
entries.note: 配lead a sedentary lifestyle；谓语用单数。

entries.example: Obesity has become a public health concern, especially among children who rarely play outdoors.
entries.exampleZh: 肥胖已成为公众健康问题，在很少户外活动的儿童中尤为突出。
entries.note: 不可数；配curb rising obesity；形容人用obese。

entries.example: Keeping a balanced diet means eating more vegetables and cutting down on sugary drinks.
entries.exampleZh: 保持均衡饮食意味着多吃蔬菜、少喝含糖饮料。
entries.note: 配keep a balanced diet；冠词a不可省。

entries.example: Good nutrition in childhood lays the foundation for a lifetime of sound health.
entries.exampleZh: 童年时期良好的营养为一生的健康奠定基础。
entries.note: 不可数；配good nutrition；勿混nutrient。

entries.example: Addicted to junk food, many students ignore vegetables and skip proper meals altogether.
entries.exampleZh: 许多学生沉迷垃圾食品，不吃蔬菜，甚至完全不吃正餐。
entries.note: 不可数；配be addicted to junk food。

entries.example: Students who skip breakfast often find it hard to concentrate on morning classes.
entries.exampleZh: 不吃早餐的学生常常难以在上午的课堂上集中注意力。
entries.note: skip意为略过；配skip meals；三单加s。

entries.example: Staying up late to scroll through phones ruins both our sleep quality and our mood.
entries.exampleZh: 熬夜刷手机既损害我们的睡眠质量，也破坏我们的情绪。
entries.note: 无被动；动名词作主语时谓语用单数。

entries.example: Many candidates burn the midnight oil before exams, only to feel exhausted afterwards.
entries.exampleZh: 许多考生考前熬夜苦读，结果事后却疲惫不堪。
entries.note: 习语，oil前用the；only to do表意外结果。

entries.example: Irregular hours have left many young professionals constantly tired and short of energy.
entries.exampleZh: 作息不规律使许多年轻职场人士长期疲惫、精力不足。
entries.note: 常用复数；配work irregular hours。

entries.example: Adequate sleep is not a luxury but a prerequisite for memory and clear thinking.
entries.exampleZh: 充足的睡眠不是奢侈品，而是记忆力和清晰思维的前提。
entries.note: 比enough书面；配get adequate sleep。

entries.example: Long-term sleep deprivation impairs judgement and weakens the body's immune system.
entries.exampleZh: 长期睡眠不足会损害判断力，并削弱人体的免疫系统。
entries.note: 不可数；配suffer from；注意deprive sb of。

entries.example: Keeping a regular routine helps us stay energetic and keeps our stress under control.
entries.exampleZh: 保持规律的作息有助于我们保持精力充沛，并将压力控制在可控范围内。
entries.note: routine指作息；可换keep regular hours。

entries.example: Universities are paying more attention to students' mental health than ever before.
entries.exampleZh: 高校比以往任何时候都更加关注学生的心理健康。
entries.note: 不可数；配safeguard；与physical health对举。

entries.example: Leisure activities and honest talks with friends safeguard our psychological well-being.
entries.exampleZh: 休闲活动和与朋友的坦诚交谈能维护我们的心理健康。
entries.note: 比mental health书面；注意拼写psychological。

entries.example: Regular exercise and hobbies are healthy ways to relieve stress after a long workday.
entries.exampleZh: 经常锻炼和培养爱好是漫长工作日之后缓解压力的健康方式。
entries.note: 配relieve/ease stress；名词形式stress relief。

entries.example: After a week of intense study, a walk in the park helps me unwind completely.
entries.exampleZh: 经过一周紧张的学习，在公园散步能让我彻底放松下来。
entries.note: 不及物，无被动；比relax更生动。

entries.example: Students are easily overwhelmed by academic pressure when final exams draw near.
entries.exampleZh: 期末考试临近时，学生很容易被学业压力压得喘不过气。
entries.note: 被动结构，介词用by；也可换with。

entries.example: Excessive anxiety about grades can undermine both performance and confidence.
entries.exampleZh: 对成绩的过度焦虑会同时损害表现和自信。
entries.note: 泛指不可数；配suffer from anxiety。

entries.example: Loneliness and constant pressure may lead to depression if no one lends a hand.
entries.exampleZh: 如果没有人伸出援手，孤独和持续的压力可能导致抑郁。
entries.note: 不可数；配suffer from depression；慎用程度词。

entries.example: Working overtime for months on end left him on the verge of burnout.
entries.exampleZh: 连续数月加班使他濒临身心俱疲的崩溃边缘。
entries.note: 不可数；on the verge of后接名词。

entries.example: A healthy work-life balance enables employees to stay productive and content.
entries.exampleZh: 健康的工作与生活平衡能让员工保持高效与满足。
entries.note: 配strike a balance；作主语谓语用单数。

entries.en: strike a balance between work and rest
entries.example: Only by striking a balance between work and rest can we sustain long-term productivity.
entries.exampleZh: 只有做到劳逸结合，我们才能保持长期的效率。
entries.note: 介词用between...and；倒装句中用动名词。

entries.example: Wholesome leisure activities recharge our batteries and broaden our horizons.
entries.exampleZh: 有益身心的休闲活动能让我们恢复精力，也能开阔眼界。
entries.note: 泛指用复数；配engage in leisure activities。

entries.example: Adopting a healthy lifestyle is the wisest investment we can make in ourselves.
entries.exampleZh: 养成健康的生活方式是我们能对自己做的最明智的投资。
entries.note: 配adopt/lead a healthy lifestyle。

entries.zh: 有益健康的；有益身心的
entries.example: Wholesome food and moderate exercise keep both body and mind in good condition.
entries.exampleZh: 有益健康的食物和适度锻炼能让身心都处于良好状态。
entries.note: 修饰food/activities；注意拼写勿漏w。

entries.example: Even nutritious food should be eaten in moderation, or it may do harm.
entries.exampleZh: 即使是营养食品也应适量食用，否则可能有害。
entries.note: 作状语，介词in；反义to excess。

entries.example: Excessive drinking damages the liver and often triggers accidents on the road.
entries.exampleZh: 过量饮酒损害肝脏，还常常引发道路事故。
entries.note: 用excessive而非much；可并列smoking。

entries.example: Children exposed to secondhand smoke suffer more respiratory infections than their peers.
entries.exampleZh: 暴露于二手烟中的儿童比同龄人更容易患上呼吸道感染。
entries.note: 不可数；配be exposed to；全文写法统一。

entries.example: Screen addiction keeps teenagers awake at night and drains their eyesight.
entries.exampleZh: 屏幕成瘾让青少年夜里难以入睡，也损害他们的视力。
entries.note: 配develop/overcome screen addiction。

entries.example: Overindulgence in fast food and video games is eroding the health of a whole generation.
entries.exampleZh: 对快餐和电子游戏的过度沉迷正在侵蚀整整一代人的健康。
entries.note: 不可数，后接介词in；作主语显精准。

entries.example: Years of staying up late have taken a heavy toll on her health.
entries.exampleZh: 多年熬夜已经严重损害了她的健康。
entries.note: 配take a heavy toll on sth；冠词a不可省。

entries.example: It takes about three weeks to develop a healthy habit such as morning jogging.
entries.exampleZh: 养成晨跑这样的健康习惯大约需要三周时间。
entries.note: develop意为养成；配a habit of doing。

entries.example: Moderate exercise three times a week is enough to keep most adults fit.
entries.exampleZh: 每周三次适度锻炼就足以让大多数成年人保持健康。
entries.note: 泛指时不可数；配take moderate exercise。

entries.example: Adequate sleep and a balanced diet help boost immunity against common infections.
entries.exampleZh: 充足睡眠和均衡饮食有助于增强对常见感染的免疫力。
entries.note: 配boost/strengthen；介词用against。

entries.example: Better medical care and healthier habits have raised average life expectancy worldwide.
entries.exampleZh: 更好的医疗条件和更健康的生活习惯提高了全球平均预期寿命。
entries.note: 不可数；配raise life expectancy；图表题常用。

entries.example: Nothing is more precious than sound health, yet it is often taken for granted.
entries.exampleZh: 没有什么比健康的身体更宝贵，然而人们常把它视为理所当然。
entries.note: 否定词加比较级表最高级；than后接名词。

entries.example: Only when we exercise regularly can we keep both body and mind in good shape.
entries.exampleZh: 只有当我们规律锻炼时，才能让身心都保持良好状态。
entries.note: Only引导状语置句首主句倒装；从句陈述语序。

entries.en: The more ___, the more likely we are to ___.
entries.example: The more we stay up late, the more likely we are to suffer from burnout.
entries.exampleZh: 我们越是熬夜，就越有可能身心俱疲。
entries.note: the more...the more结构，两分句均不倒装。

entries.en: It is high time that we ___.
entries.example: It is high time that we broke the habit of skipping breakfast and staying up late.
entries.exampleZh: 我们该改掉不吃早餐和熬夜的习惯了。
entries.note: that从句用过去式表虚拟；呼吁段首选。

entries.en: There is no denying that ___ has taken a heavy toll on ___.
entries.zh: 不可否认，……已对……造成严重损害。
entries.example: There is no denying that a sedentary lifestyle has taken a heavy toll on our health.
entries.exampleZh: 不可否认，久坐不动的生活方式已严重损害了我们的健康。
entries.note: 引出公认事实，适合首段；后接完成时。

entries.en: A sound mind in a sound body.
entries.zh: 健全的精神寓于健康的身体。
entries.example: As the old Latin saying goes, a sound mind in a sound body.
entries.exampleZh: 正如那句古老的拉丁格言所说：健全的精神寓于健康的身体。
entries.note: 出自Juvenal《讽刺诗》；身心并重类题目适用。

entries.example: Those who ruin their health chasing money forget that health is wealth.
entries.exampleZh: 那些为赚钱而毁掉健康的人忘了：健康就是财富。
entries.note: 经典谚语；爱默生有The first wealth is health。

entries.example: Doctors keep reminding us that prevention is better than cure, yet many ignore regular checkups.
entries.exampleZh: 医生不断提醒我们预防胜于治疗，但许多人仍忽视定期体检。
entries.note: 常与Erasmus的Adagia相关；预防类话题。

entries.en: Early to bed and early to rise makes a man healthy, wealthy and wise.
entries.zh: 早睡早起使人健康、富有而明智。
entries.example: Franklin's proverb—early to bed and early to rise makes a man healthy, wealthy and wise—still holds true.
entries.exampleZh: 富兰克林的谚语——早睡早起使人健康、富有而明智——至今依然成立。
entries.note: 出自《穷理查年鉴》；主语长，谓语用makes。
